info.name: Enterprise Task Manager API
info.description:
Comprehensive, production-grade Postman Collection covering all endpoints: System & Health, Auth, Workspaces, Members, Tags, Boards, Columns, Tasks, Subtasks, Comments, Activity Logs, and S3 Attachments.

All endpoints include automated environment variable chaining (tokens, workspace IDs, board IDs, task IDs) and response assertions.

item.name: 01. System & Health
item.description: Liveness, readiness probes, Prometheus RED metrics, and OpenAPI specification.

request.description: Returns 200 OK with server timestamp when Node.js HTTP server is active.
Verifies real live connections to PostgreSQL (SELECT 1) and Redis (PING). Returns 503 if degraded.
Returns standard Prometheus exposition text format with HTTP RED metrics and process telemetry.
Auto-generated OpenAPI 3.1 specification schema derived from Zod validator definitions.

item.name: 02. Authentication
item.description: User registration, argon2id password hashing, email verification, rotating refresh tokens with reuse detection, and password reset.

request.description: Creates user account, hashes password with argon2id, and queues verification email.
Consumes SHA-256 hashed verification token sent to MailHog.
Authenticates credentials, returns 15m JWT accessToken, and sets HttpOnly refreshToken cookie.
Rotates refresh token family. If an already-rotated token is reused, revokes the entire family.
Generates single-use password reset token with anti-enumeration (returns 200 even if email not found).
Resets password and invalidates all existing sessions/refresh tokens for the user.
Revokes the active refresh token family and clears the HttpOnly cookie.

item.name: 03. Workspaces
item.description: Multi-tenant workspace isolation, creation, membership retrieval, and ownership controls.

exec: console.log("Active Workspace ID set to:", json.data.id);

request.description: Creates a workspace and atomically assigns the creator as OWNER.
Returns only workspaces where the authenticated user is an active member.
Retrieves workspace summary, active member counts, and user role.
Updates workspace details. Restricted to workspace OWNER.
Cascades deletion of boards, columns, tasks, and members. Restricted to OWNER.

item.name: 04. Members & Invitations
item.description: Team collaboration, invitation lifecycle with SHA-256 tokens, and RBAC role assignments.

request.description: Lists all members and their roles (OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER, VIEWER).
Dispatches workspace invite token. Requires ADMIN or OWNER.
Accepts invitation token and adds caller to workspace with specified role.
Promotes or demotes member role. Cannot demote the sole OWNER.
Removes member from workspace. Users can also call this to leave a workspace.

item.name: 05. Tags
item.description: Color-coded workspace-scoped tags for task organization and visual categorization.

request.description: Creates a tag within the workspace. Hex color codes supported.
Retrieves all tags defined in the workspace.

item.name: 06. Boards & Columns
item.description: Kanban boards, starter columns (Backlog, In Progress, Done), Redis cache-aside reads, and column positioning.

request.description: Creates board with starter columns (Backlog, In Progress, Done) in an atomic transaction.
Lists all boards belonging to the workspace.
Returns board columns and task counts. Cached in Redis (TTL 300s); invalidated on mutations.
Updates board title and invalidates Redis cache entry.
Appends a new column with fractional positioning.
Renames or reorders column.
Deletes column and associated tasks. Invalidates board cache.
Deletes board and all nested columns and tasks.

item.name: 07. Tasks
item.description: Task lifecycle: transactional creation, idempotency keys, optimistic concurrency versioning, fractional reordering, and keyset cursor search across 1M+ rows.

header.description: SHA-256 hashed idempotency key ensuring atomic single execution.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Implement OAuth2 PKCE Authorization Flow",
  "description": "Deliver secure RFC 7636 PKCE exchange for SPA and mobile clients.",
  "status": "TODO",
  "priority": "HIGH",
  "dueDate": "2026-11-15T18:00:00.000Z"
}

request.description: Creates task, appends monthly ActivityLog row, and writes OutboxEvent in a single transaction.
Fetches full task detail including assignees, tags, subtasks, and comments.
High-performance keyset cursor pagination with parallel index streams across 1M+ tasks.
Atomic update guarded by version check. Returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT if stale.
Moves task across columns or reorders within column using midpoint fractional arithmetic.
Sets assignees and dispatches transactional assignment notification events.
Attaches or synchronizes workspace tags on task.
Sets deletedAt timestamp and appends task.deleted activity record.

item.name: 08. Subtasks
item.description: Hierarchical checklist items nested under parent tasks.

request.description: Adds subtask to parent task.
Toggles completion status or updates subtask title.
Deletes subtask from parent task.

item.name: 09. Comments
item.description: Team discussion threads with markdown body support and author relation hydration.

request.description: Posts comment on task and records activity entry.
Returns discussion thread ordered chronologically with author user details.

item.name: 10. Activity Log & Audit Trail
item.description: Enterprise monthly-partitioned audit trails capturing all state mutations with JSON metadata diffs.

request.description: Returns audit history of mutations (created, updated, moved, assigned, deleted) for a task.
Returns real-time event feed of all activity across the board.

item.name: 11. Attachments (S3 / R2 Flow)
item.description: Direct-to-storage upload pattern using pre-signed PUT and GET URLs. Server never buffers large binary files in memory.

request.description: Validates file extension and size, then returns pre-signed S3 PUT URL and storage key.
Registers uploaded object into PostgreSQL database and associates it with task.
Lists all metadata records of files attached to this task.
Generates secure time-limited GET pre-signed URL to download file directly from S3.
Deletes file from S3 bucket and removes row from Attachment table.
